road_plane_description: Approximate road-plane quadrilateral covering the central approach area.

units.speed: km/h for display only (demo; not physically calibrated)

notes: DEMO ONLY. The road-plane points are approximate and the 12 m road width and 25 m length are assumptions, not measurements. This file is only for testing the speed-processing pipeline. Do not treat the displayed km/h values as real speeds. For a physical calibration, replace the assumed world distances with measured distances on the road.
